overview.method: All 45 tablet Probability PNGs and assigned tablet-home-fold PNG were individually opened in full using view_image with detail=original and actual pixels personally examined. Every one of the 17 final IV.3/IV.8/IV.10/IV.15/IV.16 concise-option recaptures was personally re-viewed in full after completion notification; remaining 29 actual reviews were preserved and their byte hashes verified unchanged. Earlier passes included all 27 axis-corrected charts and final publication/degenerate-CLT refreshes. Tools sometimes scale tall images to 2048 px; original-pixel crops in earlier passes additionally checked the narrow Gaussian axis, Uniform captions/CDFs and degenerate CLT details region. No contact-sheet or metadata-only acceptance. Current top-level per-image SHA-256 and dimensions identify accepted final bytes; nested previous_personal_review entries are explicitly historical. No builds, browser, installations, commits, source or shared-checkout edits. Only this review JSON was written during final rereview.
overview.limitations: Static screenshot visual inspection only; not mathematical proof, interaction testing, measured contrast certification or human screen-reader review.
